body:
I lived in Washington, D.C. for all of my high school years, where I experienced a wide array of mind-altering substances. With a deviant Russian friend of mine and the convenience of the Silk Road, I had access to just about anything. My first experience with mind altering substances was of course with marijuana, however much to my dismay the only effects I experienced were tiredness and tendency to space out. I realize that to describe all of my experiences, I would bore not only myself but you, so I will briefly name off the substances I used since then. Mushrooms, DOB, DXM, 2C-I, 25C-nbome, 25I-nbome, MDMA, MDA, methylone, oxycodone, hydrocodone roxicodone (pure instant release oxycodone), DMT, LSD, dilaudid, adderall, cocaine, diphenhydramine (benadryl), methylphendiate, dexmethylphenidate,  dimenhydrinate (dramamine), zolpidem (ambien), alprazolam, etizolam, clonazepam, flubromazepam, and probably more but a lot is the point.
Before I get into the report, last week was midterms so I was eating very little and consuming constant large doses of dexmethylphenidate (Focalin), as well as smaller doses of Vyvanse, with doses of etizolam and xanax to get me to sleep. I had just discovered Focalin and to me it was incredible. It felt like cocaine, intense concentration, short plateau, euphoria, and very little comedown.
So here we go:
Woke up at 11:10 am after a dose of xanax to get me to sleep. 20 minutes later t I consumed 40 mgs of Vyvanse, along with a full size Monster Energy.
12:15: The Vyvanse is taking effect and I feel focused on the lecture and clearly follow what the professor says. The class ends and I am still aware of the Vyvanse.
1:30 : I realize that I have 2 hours to write a 5 page paper due in my writing class. I no longer have any Focalin. Immediately, I text my dealer. He allows me to enter his room and leave $20 on his desk, and take four 10mg pills of Focalin (dexmethylphenidate).
1:45: I rush to my room and crush up 20 mgs of Focalin and separate the pile into six or seven lines. Every few minutes I insufflate one while I work on my paper. The Focalin enhances my focus and gives me a rush of euphoric energy every once and a while. (Note: Focalin makes me more prone to distraction that does adderall IR)
03:30 : The 20 mgs have been insufflated and the paper is done and I rush to my  class. I sit through the class still feeling the effects of the Focalin, though clearly diminishing.
4:00 : Having purchased 40 mgs of Focalin, and with academic obligation out of my mind, I crush up another 10 mgs and snort them while playing video games.
6:00 : I succumb to the overwhelming desire to redose and insufflate another 5mgs. I continue playing video games until the effects wear off.
7:00 : Though the mentally stimulating effects of the Vyvanse and Focalin are more or less gone, I realize my heart rate is still high and sleep will be an issue. My stock of etizolam and alprazolam are empty, and all that awaits me in the medicine cabinet is a research chemical I bought on a whim known as flubromazepam. Knowing the drug takes 2 hours to take full effect, I put them aside.
9:00 : I ingest 4 yellow pills, each containing 5mgs of flubromazepam. I expect this to knock me out.
10:10 : A friend knocks at the door at asks if id like to smoke with him. I will refer to him as Kyle. We walk off campus and smoke one bowl of very pleasant marijuana.
10:15 : As I walk back to the dorm I realize my motor coordination is mildly impaired and a feeling of sedation has begun.
10:30 : Upon discovering my roommate plans to sleep, I part ways with Kyle. Confident that the combination of marijuana and flubromazepam will put me to sleep, I get into bed.
...........
2:00 am : I am unable to sleep and I dosed another 5 mgs of flubromazepam.
It seems this drug is not as potent as etizolam or alprazolam. Either that, or the Vyvanse and Focalin overpowered the effects of the flubromazepam and marijuana. I am not looking forward to the supposed 24 hour effects of this chemical.
This experience is live and I now intend to attempt sleep.
